title: The Dragon's Shed Skin
text: A dragon has shed its skin in the valley, a husk as big as a hall, split down the back where it climbed free. Its scales hang loose and shining in the wind. It still holds the dragon's warmth, and its smell, and something of its rage.

outcomes.text: Wyrmbone and scale, enough to armor a House, and edges that bite.

options.label: The toughest climbs inside the skin and wears it.

outcomes.text: They smell like dragon for a week. Things in the wild give them a very wide berth.

options.label: Burn it, so no rival has it.

outcomes.text: It burns for a day, and the smoke smells of rage.
